description: This file defines a PHP trait 'SchemaCheckTrait' used for checking configuration schema validity within Drupal. It includes methods for schema validation, handling ignored property paths, and checking data types, with references to external validation and configuration management classes.

classes.name: SchemaCheckTrait
classes.description: A PHP trait providing methods for validating configuration schemas in Drupal, including handling ignored property paths and data type checks.

methods.name: checkConfigSchema
methods.description: Validates the configuration schema for a given config name and data, optionally validating constraints, returning errors or true.

methods.name: isViolationForIgnoredPropertyPath
methods.description: Determines if a validation violation should be ignored based on configured property paths and messages.

methods.name: checkValue
methods.description: Checks a specific configuration value against its schema, returning errors if mismatched.
